title: What If Your College Assigned Your CRUSH as Your Wife?
tags: what if your college assigned you a wife
description:
Your college just sent your roommate assignment. Roommate: Lia. Relationship: wife. It's a "Partner Housing Pilot" you accepted without reading, there is only one bed, and the rules are simple: stay officially married for one year, no annulments, and keep your weekly compatibility score above 50% or you both lose the room. One problem: somebody on campus is trying to make your marriage fail.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Who did you think the saboteur was: Brett, Maya or Jake? Be honest.
2) Day 100, the annulment form is on your desk. Do you sign it or tear it up?

Subscribe before your compatibility score drops below 50%. Lia checks.

Real fact in this episode: in 1950, an MIT study of the Westgate housing complex found that people were far more likely to become friends with whoever lived just a few doors down. Closer door, closer friend.

#whatif #gusmaybe #crush #college #animation
